purpose: Teach: 長田/井口/小西/宮澤/田辺/塩川/児玉/本間

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の長田先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit your advisor Professor Nagata's research direction.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Light command weight on the verb. Composed authority without harshness. Assumes compliance as a matter of course.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。井口教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Inoue's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Quick tempo, alert. No hesitation — internalized the directive immediately. Careful precision on the verb.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の小西先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — contact Professor Konishi about the joint research collaboration.
lines.style: Same cadence as the first instruction. Calm, procedural. Names matter; slight weight on each name. Not harsh, but non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で宮澤助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend Assistant Professor Miyazawa's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Crisp affirmation. Slightly faster than before — moving through the list. Demonstrates he's already mapping out his next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の田辺先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also reference Professor Tanabe's work in the literature review.
lines.style: Steady, unhurried. Fourth instruction in sequence — tone remains consistent, authoritative but not repetitive. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の塩川先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Senior Shiokawa in the lab for guidance on that.
lines.style: Affirmative, respectful. Slight deference on the request for guidance — acknowledges hierarchy. Still attentive, still present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の児玉教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — meet with Professor Kodama about the international partnership.
lines.style: Slight increase in weight. Seventh directive. Tone stays composed but carries a sense of importance — this one matters. Clear, authoritative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、本間事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the funding application through Administrator Honma's office.
lines.style: Final confirmation — slight settling of breath. He's absorbed all of it. Respectful, methodical. Closing note of quiet commitment.
